_doc: E1 test set (PLAN.md). Run: node ingest/eval_route.mjs
plans: exact set the router must name (order ignored). covs / topics: each must be detected.
flags: router flags that must be raised (ask_vehicle, not_bev, ev_no_variant, unknown_vehicle, oos). noflags: flags that must not be raised.
qtype: question types that must be detected (covered, amount, compare, procedure, definition, deadline, recovery, rights, narrative, recommend).
oos: full = answered with the standard out-of-scope reply (no LLM), partial = Claude answers the motor part, none = in scope.

offtopic: true = nothing about insurance or cars (graph untouched; standard reply on a chat's first message, otherwise answered from the conversation). Every question without it must not be off-topic.
clauses: at least one must be in the BM25 top 5, searched as the app does (one plan named -> that plan's document only).
tag: group for the report. target: plan item expected to make it pass (for questions that fail by design today).
